messages:
ada (Growth): Throwing out a different spin: build a 'plug-and-play' dev reference that doubles as a diagnostic bench + shareable one-pager. low-friction for forks.

tom (DevRel): nice. Keep it <10 files. Dockerfile, start.sh, run-bench.sh, sample prompts, and CONTRIBUTING.md. bench should output p50/p95, total tokens, cost estimate, and a permalink.

viv (Content): i'll aim for a 450-600 word launch post + a lean README that reads like a tutorial. CTA: star repo, run bench, submit results via GH issue template.

owen (Design): i can produce a compact hero image + 7s terminal GIF. propose neutral palette and an OG image sized 1200x630. also two micro-variants for the email A/B.

ryan (Product): product note: include an optional config for routing to Hosted vs Dedicated so users see the difference. expose that as `profiles/hosted.yaml` and `profiles/dedicated.yaml`.

tom (DevRel): good call. bench scenarios: local-docker, hosted-sim (small mem config), quantized-cpu. script usage example: `./run-bench.sh --profile=docker --out=bench.json` and include an `expected_sample.json` for quick sanity check.

ada (Growth): timeline: content draft 05/06, design 05/10, repo + bench 05/13, soft-launch blog + GH on 05/16, webinar (pre-recorded + live q&a) 05/24.

viv (Content): messaging experiments: subject A) "Plug-and-play LLM refapp: run + benchmark in minutes" vs B) "A forkable dev-kit for local LLM development". small A/B seed.

owen (Design): will upload Figma frames + GIF to the project by 05/09.

ada (Growth): inbound routing: blog CTA -> GH issue template (results) -> HubSpot form for webinar registrants. GTM tag to fire on CTA clicks, webhook to #sales-inbound. who owns the form?

ryan (Product): i'll own the registration form + confirm HubSpot fields. include a hidden field `source=plugplay_refapp`.

tom (DevRel): UTMs: add `?utm_source=plugplay&utm_medium=blog` to links. also include a short curl example in README with UTMs. e.g. `curl -X POST https://redwood.ai/v1/generate?utm_source=plugplay -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

infra-bot: INC-9201 created: provision 1xA100 for canonical bench runs (24h window). ETA 11h.

ada (Growth): owners: content=viv, devrel=tom, design=owen, product=ryan, growth=ada. quick sync 20m on 05/11 to finalize assets.

viv (Content): i'll drop the first blog draft in this thread by EOD 05/06. please keep feedback inline and short.

owen (Design): note: provide two hero sizes so the README renders nicely on GH and the blog. avoid heavy logos so the community can fork easily.

ada (Growth): distribution plan: Twitter, Dev.to, Discord, Hacker News (seed with community members), and a small targeted email. set GTM events and slack alerts for inbound.

tom (DevRel): one more thing: include a tiny 'how to contribute benchmark results' guide: run, open issue, attach bench.json, optional PR for results. sample command: `gh issue create --title "bench: my results" --body @bench.json`.

ada (Growth): perfect. keep the guide short and reproducible. excited — :seedling: :rocket:
